title: 1981 New addition to HHS, cafeteria, admin offices and classrooms
description: In January 1972, a proposal was made to close Hartland High School and merge it with a new school complex near Woodstock, along with Woodstock High School. The town council strongly opposed the transfer of academic students from Hartland High School. On February 23, 1979, the council approved plans for an addition to Hartland High School. The new annex featured classrooms, a band room, a cafeteria, and offices. The official opening took place on March 21, 1981, and was attended by the Honourable Richard Hatfield.
